## Proposed families (not yet run)

| family | expected value rank | note |
|---|---|---|
| X1-ranking-loss | 1 | LambdaRank/pairwise-AUC-optimising GBM on F-R instead of logloss (optimises the metric directly) |
| X2-monotone-gbm | 2 | monotone-constrained GBM on top-30 FAILPRED features (less overfit, better holdout transfer) |
| X3-multitask | 3 | joint F-R(h) across horizons with shared representation; h as feature, pooled over 8 horizons (8x data) |
| X4-signal-density | 4 | D2 signal arrival rate vs expected given vol (signals/minute, burst count) as-of h |
| X5-trade-path-state | 5 | open-trade MAE/MFE path, time-in-trade, distance to stop/target of currently open pair trades at h |
| X6-sibling-session | 6 | same-type sessions' outcomes in prior 5/10/20 sessions with exponentially decayed weights; failure clustering (Hawkes on fails) |
| X7-cross-session-handoff | 7 | previous session end state: efficiency, close location, inventory carried, gap to next open |
| X8-vol-of-vol | 8 | realised vol-of-vol, jump share (bipower), intraday vol seasonality residual |
| X9-microstructure-noise | 9 | signature plot / noise-to-signal ratio across 1s..60s sampling, ES-NQ lead-lag at 1s |
| X10-trend-quality | 10 | Kaufman efficiency ratio, R^2 of linear fit, up/down-tick persistence multi-window at h |
| X11-oracle-gap | 11 | how much of F-R is predictable from labels of OTHER types same day (NY outcome vs Asia) - lag-clean version |
| X12-ordinal-loss-tier | 12 | ordinal target (loss tiers 0/<1R/<2R/>=2R), expected-loss regression, threshold on expected loss |
| X13-two-stage-count | 13 | stops-count NB/Poisson then residual (Block A4 variant with book split) |
| X14-stack-diversity | 14 | K2 model-of-models using disagreement between family stacks as feature |
| X15-conformal-abstain | 15 | conformal abstention: only act when conformal set singleton; coverage-conditional AUC |
| X16-regime-specific-models | 16 | separate models by VIX tercile and session type with Bayesian shrinkage to pooled |
| X17-dtw-analogs | 17 | DTW/kNN analog sessions on normalised first-h price path; label of analogs |
| X18-limit-order-book-imbalance-persist | 18 | imbalance autocorrelation decay time, depth-weighted mid vs mid drift |
| X19-time-of-day-liquidity-shock | 19 | spread/ depth shock relative to same minute-of-day history z-score |
| X20-event-distance-interactions | 20 | distance to nearest scheduled event x vol regime x session type interactions (tree depth 3) |
| X21-cost-aware-target | 21 | label by P&L after realistic extra slippage, failure of cost-adjusted edge |
| X22-trade-level-stop-gap | 22 | predict per-signal stop distance vs realised ATR ratio (G feature set from trade geometry) |
| X23-counterfactual-skip | 23 | per-signal marginal contribution label: pnl(with)-pnl(without) in R11 (regeneration labels for G) |
| X24-late-info-ensemble | 24 | ensemble over horizons of the same session (+5..+60 predictions as features for later horizon) |
| X25-noise-robust-selection | 25 | stability selection over bootstrap windows (feature kept only if selected in >=80% of 33 folds) |
